summary: CID Holdco, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a reverse stock split at a 1-for-25 ratio, approved by the board and previously authorized by stockholders on May 12, 2026. The split becomes effective May 29, 2026, with trading on a split-adjusted basis on Nasdaq on June 1, 2026, under symbol DAIC (new CUSIP 171756208). No fractional shares will be issued; cash is paid for fractional shares, and ownership percentages remain unchanged except for rounding adjustments. Continental Stock Transfer is the paying agent. The filing is a routine corporate action to maintain Nasdaq listing compliance, not a special situation event.
